hero_profiles.notes: Strong mid to late game, weak early. No dash, but camouflage is very strong in lower ranks; higher ranks can dodge his ultimate with dashes and Flicker (not easy). Easy to play but timing matters. Strong against immobile heroes and heroes that rely on targeting (camouflage). Recommended jungle pick against front-to-back drafts with an immobile backline. Close to meta (A tier).

Very recommended against certain drafts, e.g. Aulus, Lukas and dive comps — easily disrupts them. Very strong high-ground defense. Not naturally a frontline. Falls off late due to long cooldowns and more mobile enemies. Strong invade: built-in dash + stun at levels 1–2 for pickoffs. Weak to Purify and CC immunity (Diggie). Lesley is the best anti-tank into him; Karrie, X.Borg and Dyrroth get spun by his ultimate.

Out of meta — too immobile, hard to make viable. Plays as an assassin finisher from the EXP lane. Very weak early. Late game easily bursts far-back squishies (Lesley, Layla) but needs good timing. Split push is strong and must be respected, but leaves the team without an EXP frontline. Countered by defensive items and teams that stick together.

S tier with Angela, A tier without; in the meta. Sustain teamfighter, front-to-back. Easily kited early; scales hard late. Weak to anti-heal (Baxia), crowd control and kiting heroes (Karrie, Lunox). Strong against tanky EXP fighters and fighter gold laners. Alpha can win early but Alice mostly out-sustains him late. Franco's suppress is strong before Alice stacks. Lower ranks have a harder time against her.
Strong against Belerick, Carmilla and tank-heavy drafts (true damage). Falls off late. Pickoff/dive, all-in commit — can't really poke. Must land his ultimate. Estes is a strong counter.

Decent against certain drafts: strong sustain and damage against enemies without stuns (lifesteal). Bad against drafts with stunners. If he gets ahead early he snowballs very hard and farms very fast. Weak to anti-heal, hard crowd control and kiting. Much stronger in low ranks and solo queue (uncoordinated teams).

C tier — very conditional, usually not good. Works with Alice or Lukas, or high-skill assassins that go in and out with burst: Lancelot, Gusion and Hayabusa are most viable, Yi Sun-shin and Nolan possible. Without tank/sustain heroes she leaves the marksman in a very bad state. Global presence is one of her biggest advantages. Pickoff comes from her ultimate.

Very situational, B tier (A if played right). Good against burst (Kadita, Eudora, Tigreal combos that usually delete a solo target). Stays in long drawn-out teamfights and is a very good split pusher. Generally wins fights against tanks. Weak against kiters that run away (Chang'e, Lesley, Granger, Beatrix); needs the team to back him up, otherwise he split pushes. Team dependent.

Very strong — S tier if played correctly. Like Lancelot but stronger, and has crowd control too. Not a frontliner but huge damage; overwhelms enemies and makes a mess. Falls off late. Strong against teams without lockdown. Synergy with crowd-control allies. Can still deal with split pushers if played right. Usually builds lifesteal, so bring anti-heal. Countered by Phoveus (cancels dashes, out-sustains, teleports), Minsitthar and Khufra (dash cancels), Kaja (lockdown).
Very strong presence (CC ultimate control) but doesn't need a ban.

rules.description: Points when a hero has teammates with a trait it works well with (e.g. Arlott with crowd control). Counted once per trait.
Dive drafts reach poke heroes before poke wears them down.
Enchanter support (Rafaela/Floryn/Estes/Angela) with no tank and no other sustain hero on the team — drops massively.
A front-to-back team peels and punishes divers who jump in.
Enemy has 3+ high-sustain heroes and this team has no anti-heal hero.
Enemy has 2+ thick heroes and this team has no anti-tank damage.
No frontline (tank or tanky fighter).
No hero who can jungle — the team falls behind on farm and early objectives.
Enemy has a strong split pusher (e.g. Sun) and this team has no answer.
Poke wears down a slow front-to-back team before it can engage.
Points per step of a hero's rank sensitivity: added in low-rank games, subtracted in high-rank games.
Live mode: a pick whose roles are all already filled by teammates loses this many points.
Rush (Hilda/Aulus/Lukas) beats pickoff (Kalea/Nolan/Saber): rush sustain can't be burst in ranked.
Setting (live mode): share of a counter's points a pick loses while that counter is still available to the enemy.
Setting: how fast points turn into advantage (higher = flatter). At 40: 10 pts ≈ +11, 20 pts ≈ +20, 40 pts ≈ +32.
Setting (live mode): share of a hero's value to the enemy added to its pick score (taking it denies them).
Setting: points per 1.0 difference in average early/mid/late power between the teams.
Setting: in solo queue, rank-sensitive heroes count as this many ranks lower (party queue: this many higher).
All damage of one type — easy to itemize against.
Split push beats slow tank/enchanter teamfight drafts (e.g. Estes, Belerick).
A stealth hero (e.g. Aamon) against 2+ enemies that rely on targeting skills.
Points for each A-tier hero picked.
Points for each C-tier hero picked (negative = weak in the meta).
Points for each D-tier hero picked (negative = out of the meta).
Points for each S-tier (meta) hero picked.
Points when a hero faces enemy heroes with a trait it is strong against (or lost when weak against it). Counted once per trait.
Points when a hero is strong against the enemy's draft type (or lost when weak against it).
